title: TTF/HH ratio z>1 -> CF returns +2d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] TTF to Henry Hub ratio 20d z-score > 1 leads CF Industries returns by 2 days (+) as a wide EU-US gas spread hands US ammonia producers a cost advantage (mirror of null YAR.OL short result); trade long CF 3d [finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub -> finance.CF.log_return] (parent: R2-0055)
message: Supported only contemporaneously (r=0.13, n=389, best lag 0, not 2d); long-CF 1d rule after z>1 has 52% hit, negative excess return (-0.28%), OOS hit 47%; not tradable

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] TTF to Henry Hub ratio 20d z-score > 1 leads CF Industries absolute returns by 1 day (+) since the long-CF direction bet failed (negative excess return) but a wide EU-US gas spread still marks a regime shift that should raise CF realized volatility; trade long CF straddle-proxy 3d [finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub -> finance.CF.abs_return] (parent: R2-0153)
